items.title: Aaron Levie：AI本该取代程序员，但软件岗位增速反而跑赢所有行业
items.en_title: The job AI was supposed to replace is experiencing the opposite outcome
items.full_text:
The job that AI was supposed to replace is experiencing the opposite of the expected outcome. Software job postings are outpacing other fields.

Why is that? If you lower the cost of production of something that has lots of use cases, people want more things produced. We've seen this play out in the industrial world constantly, and now we're finally seeing it in knowledge work.

Because software now is much lower to cost per unit, people want way more of it. So we start to use software for all new use cases that previously were too expensive to justify.
items.author: levie
items.summary: Box CEO指出反直觉现象：AI本该取代程序员，但软件岗位招聘增速跑赢所有领域。原因是AI降低单位成本→需求爆发→总量反升。
items.analysis: 验证经济学'杰文斯悖论'——效率提升不减需求反引爆。对游戏行业：AI不会消灭开发者，但会重新定义工作内容。单位产出成本下降→市场容纳更多游戏→开发者需求不降反升。
items.recommendation: AI本该取代程序员，结果软件岗增速跑赢所有行业——Levie揭示杰文斯悖论

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol照片→纯代码3D模型反编译器，完全开源
items.en_title: GPT-5.6 Sol: throw any photo, reverse-compile into code-built 3D model
items.full_text:
3D 建模师要失业了。

这个人用 GPT-5.6 Sol 做了一个 skill：

只要扔给它任意一张照片，它就能直接把图里的物体反向编译成纯代码构建的 3D 模型。

效果如视频所示，项目已经完全开源。

完全免费。
https://t.co/uVysFEzEs6
items.author: 0xCheshire
items.summary: 开发者用GPT-5.6 Sol构建开源工具：输入任意照片即可将物体'反编译'为纯代码3D模型。项目完全免费开源。

items.recommendation: 拍照即出可编辑3D模型——GPT-5.6 Sol反编译器完全开源免费

items.title: Fable 5一个prompt构建完整Verlet绳索物理——46粒子精度
items.en_title: Asked Claude Fable 5 to create a fully interactive 3D crime board - it did it in ONE Prompt
items.full_text:
This is one of the wildest things I have built with AI so far 😱

Asked Claude Fable 5 to create a fully interactive 3D crime investigation board using @threejs and it did it in ONE Prompt.

It took one more prompt to give it a polished UI inspired by a reference design that I created with GPT Image.

What surprised me most was not how it looked. It was how it worked.

Fable built a complete Verlet rope physics system with 46 particles in every thread. It handled gravity, damping, distance constraints, and collision with pins.
items.author: thebuggeddev
items.summary: Fable 5在一个prompt内用Three.js构建完整3D犯罪调查板，自动实现Verlet绳索物理——每根线46粒子，含重力、阻尼、距离约束和碰撞。
items.analysis: Verlet积分不是简单CRUD而是需要数学和物理理解的系统工程。Fable 5在复杂技术任务上的能力已超越'能写代码'，进入'能做工程设计'领域。
items.recommendation: 一个prompt=完整物理引擎：Fable 5自动构建46粒子Verlet绳索系统

items.title: Sol Ultra全流程：参考图→Blender建模→绑定→3动画→Three.js展示
items.en_title: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra: character references → Blender → rig → 3 animations → Three.js showcase in 2h11
items.full_text:
I gave GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra a full set of character references: front T-pose, four-side turnaround, idle, walk and attack poses.

The goal was not just to generate a nice mage image. It had to rebuild the character in Blender, rig it, create 3 animations, export a real GLB and then build a complete Three.js showcase around it.

The full goal was completed in 2h11.
items.author: givros
items.summary: 给Sol Ultra完整角色参考图后，AI自动完成：在Blender中重建角色→绑定骨骼→创建Idle/Walk/Attack三个动画→导出GLB→构建Three.js展示页面。全流程2小时11分。
items.analysis: 这是AI从2D参考到3D可交互角色的端到端管线。2小时完成传统需要数天的工作量（建模+绑定+动画+导出+展示），对游戏角色制作流程是颠覆性的。
items.recommendation: 参考图→建模→绑定→3动画→展示页面：Sol Ultra 2小时11分全自动

items.en_title: Open source game engine made specifically for building 2.5D games with AI
items.full_text:
SOMEONE BUILT AN OPEN SOURCE GAME ENGINE MADE SPECIFICALLY FOR BUILDING 2.5D GAMES WITH AI

instead of using a complex general purpose engine, this one is built from the ground up for the ai workflow

it keeps everything the ai needs to control in one small, simple place, so the agent can actually understand the whole engine and build with it instead of getting lost in a giant codebase

> generate all your assets with ai, the maps, characters, props, audio and ui, then the agent drops them into the engine
items.author: om_patel5
items.summary: 专为AI工作流设计的开源2.5D引擎：代码库足够小让Agent能理解整个引擎。所有素材可由AI生成后直接导入。
items.analysis: 传统引擎数百万行代码AI无法全局理解。这个引擎反其道——极简代码+结构化API让AI端到端掌控。未来可能出现'为AI设计的引擎'和'为人设计的引擎'两条路线。
items.recommendation: 反Unreal思路：极简引擎让AI理解全部代码——开源AI-native引擎

items.title: Threenity Engine：让AI在10+15分钟内生成完整Three.js游戏UI
items.en_title: Threenity Engine: 10 min ChatGPT + 15 min Claude = modular UI easy to modify
items.full_text:
Threenity Engine: Game UI
Anyone who's made games with pure JavaScript and @threejs knows: creating a beautiful UI is very difficult.
Threenity makes it easier: 10 min chatGPT / gemini -> 15 min @claudeai / codex = modular UI that's easy to modify.
items.author: semenov_artyom
items.summary: Threenity Engine解决Three.js游戏UI难题：10分钟ChatGPT + 15分钟Claude即可生成模块化、易修改的完整游戏UI。
items.analysis: Three.js游戏开发的UI一直是痛点——没有现成UI框架。Threenity通过组件化设计让AI能快速生成可用UI，降低了浏览器3D游戏的开发门槛。
items.recommendation: Three.js游戏UI不再是噩梦：Threenity让AI 25分钟生成完整UI系统

items.title: 服务器权威多人游戏里程碑：WebTransport+延迟补偿+客户端预测
items.en_title: Server authoritative multiplayer: WebTransport, lag compensation, client prediction
items.full_text:
Huge milestone reached: server authoritative multiplayer!

• WebTransport with fallback to WebSocket for browsers that don't support it
• Server runs physics and root motion animations, and syncs to clients
• Server performs lag compensation when checking if you hit something
• Client predicts your own character's movement so it feels nice and snappy, interpolates other characters

No Area of Interest yet, but that's not a priority right now because there's only 1 player so far (me)
items.author: jallen_dev
items.summary: 独立开发者达成服务器权威多人游戏里程碑：WebTransport+WebSocket降级、服务器物理+动画同步、延迟补偿命中检测、客户端预测移动+插值其他角色。
items.analysis: 浏览器端实现完整的服务器权威网络架构（包括延迟补偿和客户端预测）是技术难度很高的工作。这为浏览器多人游戏提供了技术参考——不再需要妥协用客户端权威。
items.recommendation: 浏览器多人游戏技术突破：WebTransport+延迟补偿+客户端预测全栈实现

items.title: 本地27B LLM通过MCP在Unreal Engine 5中构建完整游戏
items.en_title: Can a local LLM build a game inside UE5? Qwen3.6 27B via llama.cpp + UE 5.8 native MCP
items.full_text:
Can a local LLM actually build a game inside Unreal Engine 5?

A lot of you asked me to test this after my previous MCP video, so I took Qwen3.6 27B, ran it locally through llama.cpp, connected it to UE 5.8 new native MCP, and tried to build a full game.

I got surprisingly far, but I also spent a lot of time fighting the setup, context, and model configuration. This is definitely not the same experience, but if you set it right it can work well.
items.author: Stefan_3D_AI
items.summary: 使用本地Qwen3.6 27B模型通过llama.cpp连接UE 5.8原生MCP尝试构建完整游戏。结果'出人意料地走了很远'，但配置过程消耗大量时间。
items.analysis: 本地LLM+UE5的组合代表了'隐私优先'的AI游戏开发路线——不需要将代码发送到云端。UE 5.8原生MCP支持降低了集成门槛，但27B模型的能力天花板仍明显低于云端前沿模型。
items.recommendation: 本地27B模型通过MCP驱动UE5开发游戏：'走得出人意料地远'
